item.title: IGL: yet another image viewer
item.description: Showcasing igl, a home-made bitmap image viewer app.

item.description: A few notes on oauth2 authorization code flow.

item.title: A quick look at fuel prices in Brazil
item.description: A simple dashboard showing how fuel prices have evolved in Brazil since 2004 until 2018. Just a set of plots organized by time and brazillian regions. Results discussion is left to the reader.

item.title: Quick setup of a proxyDHCP with dnsmasq and PXE boot
item.description: Jotting down some notes on how to setup a proxyDHCP using dnsmasq in order to boot a device from a network rather than from a local drive.

item.title: Building python wheels for many linux-es
item.description: On building and pushing python wheels for Linux. An example is shown with nb-cpp, a python package implemented in C++ with pybind11.
